Unnumbered.tip: This slide stays in the show but gets no number of its own; its page-number field shows the previous slide’s.
Unnumbered.why: 'Unnumbered' is a state, not a choice; say what the switch does

Stays in the show but takes no page numb.en: Stays in the show without a number of its own — its page-number field shows the previous slide’s. Use it for build-up steps or a divider that shouldn’t count.
Stays in the show but takes no page numb.why: 'morph steps', 'card' are jargon; 'reveal' clashes with click-reveal

Number hidden slides.tip: On: hidden slides keep their number, so the others don’t renumber when you hide one (as in PowerPoint). Off: the audience sees no gaps in the numbering.
Number hidden slides.why: label is fine but the trade-off is invisible without a tooltip

Corner arrows.tip: Deck-wide. Show clickable ‹ › arrows in the corner while presenting. Off by default — clicks and arrow keys already move between slides.
Corner arrows.why: current tip says 'Reveal’s own navigation arrows' (reveal.js internals; clashes with our 'Reveal'); and the tip has no translation in any catalog

Transition.tip: How this slide comes in. Morph moves matching elements from the previous slide into place.

Name.tip: Optional. Shown in the Link to and Variant of lists and on variant thumbnails, so this slide is easy to pick.
Name.why: on the Interact tab a bare 'Name' reads as the element’s name; tip mentioned 'state badges'

State of.tip: Make this slide a variant of another slide: arrow keys skip it, the audience opens it by clicking a linked element, and matching elements morph between the two.
State of.why: user could not understand 'State of'; 'state' is a developer word

A state is hidden from arrow-key flow —.en: Make this slide a variant of another slide: arrow keys skip it, the audience opens it by clicking a linked element, and matching elements morph between the two.
A state is hidden from arrow-key flow —.why: this .title overrides the ROW_TIPS entry; same text, new term, no 'ids'

no — normal slide.why: 'no' answers a yes/no question the label no longer asks

Pull elements added to the parent into t.en: Copies in elements added to the main slide since, and follows its layer order. Your changes in this variant are kept.

Hover.tip: While presenting, what happens when the pointer rests on an element that has a Hover group: dim the other groups, or switch which content shows.
Hover.why: bare 'Hover' does not say it is a behaviour choice; old tip used 'reveal swaps content sets; focus-group'

focus-group.why: raw model value shown as an option (English UI literally says 'focus-group'); needs labeledSelect([['focus-group', t('Dim other groups')], …])

reveal.why: raw model value; 'reveal' already means click-by-click reveal elsewhere; needs labeledSelect

Hover dim.tip: How visible the other groups stay while one is pointed at: 0 = hidden, 1 = no fading. 0.15 is a soft fade.
Hover dim.why: 'Hover dim' is a noun pile; the number is the others’ opacity

Default set.tip: The Hover group whose content shows before the pointer is on anything. Empty = nothing extra.
Default set.why: 'set' is an implementation word; say when it shows

Preview set.tip: Which Hover group’s content the canvas shows while you edit. Doesn’t change the show.

While presenting, hovering an element wh.en: While presenting, pointing at an element shows the content whose Show on hover of matches its Hover group. Pick a group in Preview on canvas to edit its content.
While presenting, hovering an element wh.why: names the real fields instead of 'set'/'group'

Show on hover.tip: Type a Hover group name: this element stays hidden until the pointer is on an element of that group (slide’s On hover: Switch content). Empty = always visible.
Show on hover.why: the value is a group name; label now reads as a sentence with it

Group.tip: A name shared by elements that react to the pointer together while presenting (see On hover on the slide). Not the same as ⌘G grouping.
Group.why: same word as ⌘G Group (select/move together) — a different feature; the shared key is also translated as a verb (pt 'Agrupar', zh-Hans '编组'). The Interact row needs its OWN key; context-menu 'Group' stays

＋ New state linked from this element.en: ＋ Link to a new variant of this slide
＋ New state linked from this element.why: 'state' jargon; lead with what the author gets

Duplicates this slide as a hidden intera.en: Copies this slide as a variant and links this element to it: while presenting, clicking the element opens the copy. Edit the copy to show what changes.
Duplicates this slide as a hidden intera.why: explains the outcome and the next step

Role.tip: What this text is in the layout (title, body…). Apply layout uses it to put content in the matching place.
Role.why: bare 'Role' says nothing about layouts; it sits at the top of every element

Backdrop.why: it is a frosted-glass blur of what is behind the element; de/es/fr/it/pt translate it as 'background'

Blend.tip: How this element mixes with what is underneath — Multiply darkens, Screen lightens.

Morph id.tip: Elements with the same morph name on neighbouring slides morph into each other. Until you change it, it is the element’s own name.

Pair with.tip: Pick an element on another slide; this one takes its morph name and morphs into it.

Don’t pair — use its own id.en: Don’t pair — use its own name

Another element on this slide already us.en: Another element on this slide already uses that morph name.

Morphs as <code>{id}</code>, overriding.en: Morphs as {id} instead of its own name, {own}. Choose “Don’t pair” below to undo.
Morphs as <code>{id}</code>, overriding.why: points at the real undo control

Elements sharing a morph id morph into e.en: Elements with the same morph name morph into each other between slides. Rename it, or pick below, to pair it with an element on another slide.

Enter.tip: How the element appears when the slide comes in. Skipped when it morphs in from the previous slide.
Enter.why: 'Enter' reads as the Enter key (pt left it untranslated as 'Enter'); tip mentioned 'equal order', a field that is not in the UI

fade-up.why: raw model value as option label; needs labeledSelect

fade-down.why: raw model value; missing from every catalog

slide-left.why: raw model value, and ambiguous: slide-left starts at the right and moves left; missing from every catalog

slide-right.why: raw model value, ambiguous direction; missing from every catalog

slide-up.why: raw model value; missing from every catalog

slide-down.why: raw model value; missing from every catalog

Reveal step.tip: 0 = shown with the slide. 1 = appears on the first click or → press, 2 = on the second, and so on. Elements with the same number appear together.
Reveal step.why: 'step' + a bare number is opaque; say when it appears

Ambient.tip: Slow, continuous Ken Burns motion while the slide is on screen — made for full-bleed photos.
Ambient.why: 'Ambient' is vague; the only option is pan & zoom

kenburns.why: raw model value 'kenburns' shown in English UI; needs labeledSelect

Zoom.tip: Drift: an endless slow pan and zoom. Zoom out / Zoom in: one smooth zoom each time the slide appears.
Zoom.why: the Ken Burns row and the picture Crop row share the key 'Zoom', so the crop zoom shows a Ken Burns tooltip; rename ONLY the Ken Burns row (:844), keep 'Zoom' for Crop (:1979)

Zoom secs.tip: How long one pan-and-zoom pass takes, in seconds

dash-march.why: raw model value as option label; needs labeledSelect

motion-path.why: raw model value as option label; needs labeledSelect

Loop secs.tip: How long one lap takes — lower is faster
Loop secs.why: 'secs' abbreviation; the tip repeated the label

Path.why: bare 'Path' is ambiguous next to shape paths

Lap easing.tip: How the speed changes during one lap — constant, or easing in and out at the ends

Start tip.why: 'tip' collides with tooltip/tips; Office says arrow begin/end

Ghost cut — the selection fades until yo.en: Cut to move — the selection fades until you paste it in its new place; Esc cancels

Presenting ▸ Loop.why: points at a section and row that no longer exist

Give an element a motion-path loop, then.en: Choose Follow a path, then Edit path on canvas
Give an element a motion-path loop, then.why: uses the visible option name instead of 'motion-path'

Format — show or hide the properties pan.en: Show or hide the Format, Animate and Interact panel (])
Format — show or hide the properties pan.why: the panel is no longer only Format; adds the shortcut

Notes for presenter view (press S while.en: Notes for the speaker view (press S while presenting)…
Notes for presenter view (press S while.why: the app calls it 'speaker view' everywhere else
